author: jameslg

title: Extremely fun group experience
text: We had a fantastic time on the giant paddle boards. The team at Paddle Surf were really friendly and fun throughout. We played a load of different games and for many of us in the group it was the highlight of our holiday. I'd recommend to any visitors who want a fun experience and a splash in the river!

title: Great experience
text:
We were a group of 12 friends, 6 were on a giant paddle and 6 others on individual paddles. We loved the activity. Our guides Pedro and Rodrigo were adorable. They gave us advice and let us go at our own pace.
Many thanks for their Welcoming, it was an unforgettable experience.
